scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:billing && npm run build:accounts && npm run build:trading && npm run build:shell
scripts.dev: npm run generate:types && npm run build:billing && npm run build:accounts && npm run build:trading && concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -n api,api-java,billing,accounts,trading,shell -c blue,red,yellow,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:api-java" "npm run dev:billing" "npm run dev:accounts" "npm run dev:trading" "npm run dev:shell"
scripts.kill:dev: bash -c 'P=$(lsof -ti :3000 -i :5173 -i :5174 -i :5175 -i :5176 -i :8088 -i :8085 | sort -u); if [ -z "$P" ]; then echo "no dev processes on 3000/5173-5176/8088"; exit 0; fi; echo "$P" | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; S=$(lsof -ti :3000 -i :5173 -i :5174 -i :5175 -i :5176 -i :8088 -i :8085 | sort -u); if [ -n "$S" ]; then echo "$S" | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; fi; echo "dev ports cleared"'
